source: Cboe DataShop public reference files and public Option Trades sample
purpose: Reconcile every trade_condition_id and exchange_id observed in the 2026-01-07 public sample against official current Cboe reference mappings, without treating current mappings as historical effective-dated truth.
decision: Even if every observed code maps, eligibility is limited to explicitly documented regular/normal option-trade conditions. All other condition types remain quarantined. Effective dates and historical mapping vintages must be verified before backtesting.
